clusters.name: job1-plugin-split
clusters.executionModeRationale: All nine stories live in the same plugin and several mutate the same load-bearing files (data-edit-core.mjs, sync-core.mjs) plus the shared version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS/marketplace-index surfaces, so they must serialize within one impl member to avoid conflicting writes. US-101 is the foundation; US-104 (write core, the 3-step misfile move) is the heaviest.

clusters.name: job2-codexu-migration
clusters.executionModeRationale: Separate repo (codexu). HARD-gated on Job 1 being shipped AND the installed plugin updated to 2.12.0 AND any long-running watcher/MCP restarted — migrating or reading under the old single-file loader/cached reader would silently drop the 231 cold tasks. Cannot be expressed in the same /implement-with-ralph PRD as Job 1; run as a separate Ralph job after the operator gate.
